quote: You know what I like about people? They stack so well.
chinese: 你知道我喜欢人哪一点吗？会排队。
speaker_scene: Frank; Freddy's barbecue; opening direct address
reason: Compact, memorable observation with a clean question-to-punchline turn.

quote: In a town where everyone's so carefully reinventing themselves, what I like about Freddy is that he doesn't even pretend to change.
chinese: 这个城市的每个人都在精心地改头换面，而弗莱迪的可贵之处，就是他甚至不装作要改变。
speaker_scene: Frank; Freddy's barbecue; opening direct address
reason: Strong contrast between public reinvention and an unperformed identity.

quote: Every Tuesday I sit down with the speaker and the majority leader to discuss the week's agenda. Well, discuss is probably the wrong word. They talk while I sit quietly and imagine their lightly salted faces frying in a skillet.
chinese: 我每周二都会和议长及多数党领袖一起商讨一周的事宜。说是“商讨”可能不太准确。他们谈话，而我安静地坐着，想象他们淡腌过的脸在煎锅中炸。
speaker_scene: Frank; Capitol routine; opening direct address
reason: A complete character-voice aside, but violent dark humor keeps it out of daily imitation.

quote: Glendon Hill fronts San Corp Industries. San Corp is deep into natural gas. I don't give a hoot about natural gas, but I have 67 deputy whips, and they all need cash to win races. San Corp helps me purchase loyalty, and in return they expect mine. It's degrading, I know, but when the tit's that big, everybody gets in line.
chinese: 格兰顿-希尔为桑科工业做说客。桑科的天然气做得有声有色，但我才不在乎天然气。我有67位副手，他们都需要钱来赢得竞选。桑科帮我买到了忠诚，也指望我以忠心相报。我知道这很下作，但利润如此丰厚，谁都想分一杯羹。
speaker_scene: Frank; cafeteria; San Corp explanation to the audience
reason: Clear causal explanation of money, loyalty, and political leverage; the final metaphor is strong but vulgar.

quote: Money is the McMansion in Sarasota that starts falling apart after ten years. Power is the old stone building that stands for centuries. I cannot respect someone who doesn't see the difference.
chinese: 金钱是萨拉索塔的巨无霸豪宅，保质期就只有十年。权力是古老的石砌建筑，能屹立数百年。我要怎么尊重这都不懂的人？
speaker_scene: Frank; cafeteria; direct address on money versus power
reason: A complete parallel contrast with durable, reusable rhetorical structure.

quote: Setbacks are a dime a dozen with a bill of this size.
chinese: 这么大的法案，挫折在所难免。
speaker_scene: Frank; Linda; White House bill setback
reason: Short, idiomatic reassurance that works as a reusable workplace line; context clarifies the stakes.

quote: This is major reform, a complete overhaul. That would usually take months. Well, we only have days, not months. But think of the process. I asked my colleagues, your superiors, who the brightest minds in education were. They selected the six of you in this room. Now, I realize it is a difficult task, but we have the opportunity to make history here. And I want all of us to make it together. So good luck. We're counting on you.
chinese: 这是一项重大改革，全面改革。一般都要几个月呢。我们只有几天，没有几个月。但想想这个过程。我询问我的同事，你们的上司，教育界最聪明的人是谁。千挑万选，选中了你们，这间房里的六位。我知道任务艰巨，但我们现在有机会创造历史。我希望大家能齐心协力。祝好运，靠你们了。
speaker_scene: Frank; education working group; bill briefing
reason: Complete persuasive briefing with time pressure, credibility, and a collective call to action.

quote: What a martyr craves more than anything is a sword to fall on, so you sharpen the blade, hold it at just the right angle, and then 3, 2, 1--
chinese: 烈士最渴求的就是壮烈牺牲，所以你磨好兵刃，调整好角度，默数三、二、一……
speaker_scene: Frank; Blythe office; direct address after steering a resignation
reason: Complete metaphorical explanation of how a sacrifice is engineered; the countdown is a memorable landing.

quote: The truth is my heart is not in this fight. You know me. I'm not a wheeler-dealer. I can put my mind to policy, but I'm no good at this brand of politics.
chinese: 实际上，我的心根本不在这儿。你也知道，我不会精明算计。我全心投入制定政策，但没什么政治手腕。
speaker_scene: Donald Blythe; Frank; education bill handoff
reason: Self-assessment built from concession, contrast, and a clear limitation.

quote: He has no idea we've got six kids in the next room already working on a new draft. Stamper! But why dampen his mood by telling him? We just gave him a great gift-- a chance to fulfill his destiny.
chinese: 他不知道我们找了六个孩子在隔壁，紧锣密鼓地拟定新草案。斯坦普，何必要说出来让他伤心呢？我们刚刚给了他份大礼，让他能完成使命。
speaker_scene: Frank; Blythe office; direct address after Blythe leaves
reason: Ironic reframing turns a concealed takeover into a “gift”; useful for studying euphemism and moral inversion.

quote: It looks positively medieval, doesn't it? And to turn my only sanctuary into a fitness dungeon. I won't have it.
chinese: 看上去像中世纪文物，不是吗？把我仅有的圣殿变成健身地牢。我绝不容忍。
speaker_scene: Frank; Claire; home gym argument
reason: Complete comic metaphor and boundary-setting line; memorable but highly character-specific.

quote: I'm not saying there's a story. All I'm saying is that there's a question that needs to be answered. This is a nominee for Secretary of State. We have an editorial on Palestine and Israel, which he didn't write, which we don't know he didn't write.
chinese: 我没说这是新闻。我不过认为这是个应该提出的问题。这可是国务卿提名人，而我们手上有份巴以社论，却不是他写的，但我们无法确认这点。
speaker_scene: Zoe; Lucas; Herald newsroom; Kern lead
reason: A useful journalistic reasoning pattern: avoid overclaiming while naming the question that must be answered.

quote: Either you're lying, and you can fuck off; or you're telling the truth, and you can absolutely fuck off.
chinese: 你要么是在撒谎，那就滚蛋；要么没在撒谎，那就更得滚蛋。
speaker_scene: Peter; Roy; car encounter
reason: Memorable conditional ultimatum, retained for recognition only because of profanity and narrow scene use.

quote: All I want for that money is your silence. The guy you were with the other night, the one who was arrested, do you know who he was? There was no congressman. There was no arrest. None of that exists. All that exists is the money sitting right there in front of you. Do you understand?
chinese: 我只想用这笔钱买你闭嘴。那天晚上跟你在一起的男人，那个被逮捕的，你知道他是谁吗？没有什么议员，也没有逮捕这回事。没有那回事。有的只是你面前的这沓钱。明白了吗？
speaker_scene: Peter; sex-work apartment; buying silence
reason: A complete coercive negotiation with strong repetition, but the plot and threat make it recognition-only.

quote: She's right. I should take better care of myself. But it's the principle. I won't be a slave to anybody or anything you can order with a toll-free number.
chinese: 她是对的。我应该照顾好自己。但这是原则问题。我绝不受人，或者免费电话能订购的东西摆布。
speaker_scene: Frank; Claire; home, after the gym argument; direct address
reason: Self-correction pivots into a crisp principle statement and a highly reusable “I won't be a slave to…” frame.

quote: Oh, fuck that. He's a fraud. Nah, he's worse than a fraud. He's a fucking farce. I'll tell you something. He used to be even more of a maniac than I am. Chemicals? No. Politics. Oh, we had some nights, man. Long conversations, dangerous fucking notions. Like what? You name it-- OPEC, Pinochet, the fucking Food Stamp Act. Then the motherland sang her mating call. O say can you-- Next thing, he's cramming for the bar at Bryn Mawr and snapping on a flag pin. Does Bryn Mawr have a law school? My point is, he started goose-stepping in the marionette parade. Left, right; red, blue; Democrat, Republican. We're all dangling from the same strings. Take a sledgehammer to the whole fucking Punch and Judy show. That's what's required.
chinese: 去他的，他是个骗子。不，他还不如骗子呢，他就是个跳梁小丑。我跟你说，他一度比我还疯狂。是说吸毒吗？不，是在政治上。我们曾经彻夜长谈，讨论危险的想法。比如呢？什么都有：石油输出国组织、皮诺切特、该死的食品券法案。后来祖国唱起了求偶之歌。接着他就跑去布尔茅尔为考律师埋头苦学，还别上了国旗胸针。布尔茅尔有法学院吗？反正他自此正式加入了牵线木偶的队列。左派右派，红营蓝营，民主共和，我们都被同一根线吊着。给这该死的木偶戏致命一击吧。这才是该做的。
speaker_scene: Frank; Remy; home; political history and rant
reason: High rhetorical density and parallelism, retained for recognition because of profanity, named entities, and context load.

quote: How did it go? There were a few tears here and there and some anger, but nothing unexpected. I'm going to need you to leave us today, too, Evelyn. I'm sorry. I just can't have any doubt about the direction I'm taking.
chinese: 还顺利吗？不少人都流了眼泪，还有些怒气，但都在预料之中。你今天也得离开公司，伊夫林。我很抱歉，但我的决策方向容不得一丝质疑。
speaker_scene: Claire; Evelyn; CWI; firing conversation
reason: Complete difficult-conversation arc: check in, name the reaction, deliver the decision, state the boundary.

quote: I'm 59 years old. Nobody hires anybody my age. Whatever kind of reference you give me, what am I applying for, a cashier? How do I tell my daughter? I'm sorry, Evelyn. I'm truly sorry. No, you're not. You don't give a fuck.
chinese: 我已经59岁了。没人会雇我这把年纪的员工。你要什么样的推荐信我都……去应聘什么，收银员吗？我该怎么告诉我女儿？我很抱歉，伊夫林，真心抱歉。不，你没有。你压根不在乎。
speaker_scene: Evelyn; Claire; CWI; firing conversation
reason: A complete emotional statement that names age, practical consequence, family impact, and distrust.

quote: I know today has been tough. A lot of your colleagues have left, and I owe you an explanation. Many of those who left us today helped build the CWI from the ground up, and I'm grateful to them. But it is time for us to evolve, and to accomplish this, we had to make hard choices and bring in new people. That's what today was about. You have any questions, my door is always open.
chinese: 我知道今天大家很难熬。你们很多同事离开了，而我欠你们一个解释。今天离开我们的很多人帮我一手创建了净水计划，我对他们心怀感激。但是我们要更上一层楼了。为达成这一目标，我们必须做出艰难的抉择，引进新人才。这就是今天的意义。有任何问题，随时欢迎来找我。
speaker_scene: Claire; CWI team; post-restructuring address
reason: Complete change-management speech with acknowledgement, rationale, and an invitation for questions.

quote: I can link Kern directly to the Williams editorial.
chinese: 我能证明《公报》社论是科恩写的。
speaker_scene: Zoe; Lucas; Herald newsroom; first Kern lead
reason: Evidence chain stated without overclaiming: source, person, and relationship.

quote: I've got a guy named Roy Kapeniak who was on the editorial staff when Kern was there.
chinese: 有个叫罗伊·科佩尼科的人，他是科恩任主编时的一名编辑人员。
speaker_scene: Zoe; Lucas; Herald newsroom; first Kern lead
reason: Evidence chain stated without overclaiming: source, person, and relationship; split after Lucas's intervening “What?”.

quote: I have him on record saying Kern wrote every word of the editorial.
chinese: 我有他的公开声明，称那篇社论出自科恩笔下。
speaker_scene: Zoe; Lucas; Herald newsroom; second Kern lead
reason: A compact evidence claim with a useful “on record saying…” reporting frame; separated at the intervening interruption.

quote: No. You let this story play out on its own time. They'll announce in the morning. I'm sorry. If not that, what story are we talking about? Catherine Durant. As soon as Kern withdraws, you say she'll be the replacement. Is that true? It will be after you write it.
chinese: 不。你不要抢着报道，这事要按它自己的节奏发展。他们明早就会宣布。不好意思，如果不是这篇，我们在说什么新闻？凯瑟琳·杜兰特。等科恩退出之后，你马上就说她会顶上来。真的吗？你写出来就成真了。
speaker_scene: Frank; Zoe; Herald/phone handoff; controlling the next story
reason: Shows timing control, deliberate omission, and the causal power of publication.

quote: Say that name: Catherine Durant. Say it over and over. Tomorrow afternoon, write it down, and then watch that name come out of the mouth of the President of the United States. This is where we get to create.
chinese: 说出她的名字：凯瑟琳·杜兰特。一遍一遍地念叨。明天下午，写出来，然后就等着这名字从美国总统嘴里说出来吧。这是我们创造历史的契机。
speaker_scene: Frank; Zoe; Herald; rhetorical address after planting the Durant story
reason: High-value repetition and imperative structure, but it is directed at Zoe rather than the camera; kept as an expression, not mislabeled as an aside.

quote: Right place, right time, I suppose. We like her, don't we? Very much. Question is, does she like San Corp as much as we like her? I would say that that is a very good bet. But then again, I'm not a betting man. No. You always like a sure thing. When it avails itself.
chinese: 来得早不如来得巧。我们喜欢她吗？非常喜欢。问题是她是否像我们喜欢她一样喜欢桑科？我觉得值得压一注。但话说回来，我不是个赌徒。不，你喜欢板上钉钉的事。如果有的话。
speaker_scene: Frank; Remy; final café; San Corp payoff
reason: Compact closing exchange with idioms and a dry “sure thing” callback; plot-specific, so on-demand.
